detailReasons.label: 功能/使用场景不符合
detailReasons.symptom: 功能不足、功能过剩或无法满足会议、直播、教学等目标场景。
detailReasons.action: 按场景提供选型表，前置说明功能边界，减少型号误购。
examples: Las prestaciones del producto no se ajustan a las requeridas para el proyecto.
Not as Expected|device get too hot|no

detailReasons.label: 连接/设备识别问题
detailReasons.symptom: 连接电脑后无反应、无法识别、黑屏或频繁断连。
detailReasons.action: 复核USB枚举、线材/端口兼容、软件识别和长时间稳定性。
examples: Kamera verliert immer wieder die Verbindung. Getestet mit verschiedenen USB-C Kabeln und Geräten. Scheint ein Wackelkontakt zu sein.

detailReasons.label: 改变主意/不再需要
detailReasons.symptom: 需求变化、重复购买、已有替代品或单纯不再需要。
detailReasons.action: 作为非产品责任项单独追踪，避免稀释技术问题。

detailReasons.label: 发热/供电异常
detailReasons.symptom: 机身过热、供电不稳、无法开机或充电表现异常。
detailReasons.action: 复核长时温升、不同电源规格和线材压降。
examples: Not as Expected|device get too hot|no

detailReasons.label: 接口/协议/配件不匹配
detailReasons.symptom: USB、HDMI、NDI、网口、转接器或遥控器与现有设备不匹配。
detailReasons.action: 明确接口、协议、必需配件和不支持的转接链路。
examples: Kamera verliert immer wieder die Verbindung. Getestet mit verschiedenen USB-C Kabeln und Geräten. Scheint ein Wackelkontakt zu sein.

detailReasons.label: 曝光/色彩/低光表现
detailReasons.symptom: 过曝、欠曝、色彩或白平衡异常，暗光噪点明显。
detailReasons.action: 按光照场景回归曝光和白平衡，优化自动模式默认值。

detailReasons.label: 损坏/划痕/缺件/包装
detailReasons.symptom: 收到时存在破损、划痕、疑似二手、包装异常或附件缺失。
detailReasons.action: 区分出厂、仓储和运输责任，强化外观与装箱稽核。

detailReasons.label: 软件安装/设置复杂
detailReasons.symptom: OBSBOT Center安装、加载、权限或参数设置困难。
detailReasons.action: 简化首次连接流程，增加失败提示、一键诊断和售后指引。
examples: Supporting cam operating software does not load and disappointed with the product…..

reviewComments.title: OBSBOT Does It Again
reviewComments.text: I originally got this for my husband, but now I want to keep it for myself…I’ve tested quite a few webcams over the years, and this one immediately stood out for its thoughtful design. The foldable body is incredibly compact and lightweight, making it easy to toss into a laptop bag without worrying about damaging the lens. I also appreciate that folding it closed puts it to sleep, giving you a simple, physical privacy cover instead of relying only on software. This is especially great because the built-in camera on my laptop seems to never want to grant access to Google Chrome whenever I try t
reviewComments.translation: 客户认为折叠设计轻巧便携，合上即可休眠并形成实体隐私保护；整体设计考虑周到。

reviewComments.title: 持ち運びやすさと画質のバランスが良く、オンライン会議から配信まで幅広く使えるWebカメラ
reviewComments.text: ■はじめに結論からWebカメラはこれまで何台か使ってきましたが、本製品は「コンパクトなのに画質がしっかりしている」という印象が一番強く残りました。折りたたみ式なので持ち運びや収納がしやすく、1/2インチセンサーを採用していることもあって、一般的なノートPC内蔵カメラよりも映像が自然で明るく感じます。AIによる自動フレーミングや高速オートフォーカスも便利で、テレワークやオンライン会議だけでなく動画撮影にも十分活用できそうです。■質感本体はマットな質感で、安っぽさは感じませんでした。折りたたみ機構もスムーズに動き、開閉時のガタつきも少なく、全体的にしっかり作られている印象です。軽量ながら剛性感もあり、頻繁に持ち歩く用途でも安心感があります。■開封時の匂い開封時に気になるような樹脂臭や化学的な匂いは特に感じませんでした。そのまますぐ設置して使用できたので、この点は好印象でした。■サイズ感想像していたよりもコンパクトでした。折りたたむと非常に薄くなり、ノートPCケースやガジェットポーチにも無理なく収納できます。出張や外出先へ持ち運ぶ機会が多い方にも扱いやすいサイズだと思います。■使用感実際にオンライン会議で使用してみると、映像はシャープで色味も自然でした。オートフォーカスの反応も速く、手元の物を見せたり顔との距離が変わったりしても比較的スムーズにピントが合います。AI自動フレーミングも違和
reviewComments.translation: 客户认为便携性与画质平衡良好；画面自然明亮，AI自动构图和快速自动对焦适用于会议与视频拍摄。

reviewComments.title: Absolutely outstanding little camera! Very good for the price.
reviewComments.text: The Osbot Meet Flip 4k arrived very well packaged with a clear seal on its box, Which I like to see with electronic products.First of all I'm a big fan of Osbot products, So I was super interested in reviewing this new model. I've had many of their webcams before and they have all performed excellently in my testing, and i especially love their tiny series.What I love about this camera is the privacy feature, You just simply flip it down and the camera turns off, So you know you're not being listened to or recorded if you're computer has been compromised in any way.This is a big win for privac
reviewComments.translation: 客户认可包装、体积、价格与整体表现，并表示此前使用OBSBOT摄像头的体验良好。

reviewComments.title: Compact webcam with excellent image quality
reviewComments.text: I got this mainly for video calls and meetings, and it's a very impressive little webcam. The foldable design makes it easy to carry around, and the built-in stand is surprisingly practical if you're moving between different setups. Folding it closed for privacy is also a nice touch.The image quality is excellent thanks to the larger sensor, producing a much clearer and brighter picture than most built-in laptop webcams. Autofocus is quick and reliable, and the AI framing keeps you centred without being overly aggressive. The microphones also pick up voices clearly, so I didn't need to use a s
reviewComments.translation: 客户主要用于视频通话和会议，认可折叠便携、内置支架、隐私设计和画质表现。

reviewComments.title: Versatile and intelligent webcam
reviewComments.text: The OBSBOT Meet Flip 4K webcam is versatile and innovative with advanced features and sleek design. Its 1/2" CMOS sensor and HDR capability deliver true-to-life video quality. It's suitable for professional meetings, presentations, or content creation. The compact and foldable design with an integrated stand allows for quick setup and portability. The light weight makes it convenient to carry and use on the go. The dual microphones provide natural audio. It provides multiple modes to adapt to different environments.Its intelligent AI features include auto framing, PDAF focus, gesture control,
reviewComments.translation: 客户认可1/2英寸CMOS、HDR画质、智能功能和折叠设计，认为适合专业会议、演示和内容创作。

reviewComments.title: Super Slim Compact 4K@30 or 1080P@60 HDR Webcam
reviewComments.text: OBSBOT already has some compact webcams, such as the current Meet 2, but this latest Meet Flip 4K is unbelievably slim in comparison while also improving privacy functionality with a flip of the camera body. It literally "flips" up to reveal the camera and LED indicator with a very smooth hinge mechanism. When you flip it down, the camera and indicator are now hidden with complete privacy, and it goes immediately into "sleep mode". The mount, which is integrated into the body of the Meet Flip 4K, is also hinged with soft silicone underneath, so it grips with ease, or you can use the standard t
reviewComments.translation: 客户认为Meet Flip比Meet 2更纤薄，并认可翻转隐私结构以及4K 30fps、1080P 60fps HDR规格。
